title: Persona baseline decision register
banner: PROPOSED NEW BASELINE. NOT A RECOVERED ORIGINAL. NOT FROZEN. NOT ADOPTED.

The original canonical document for this persona was not recovered. This document is a new design prepared from recovered evidence, existing frozen persona contracts and the executable authority contracts, for product specification review.

It grants no authority. Every institutional authority decision it names is outstanding. Engineering implementation and synthetic authorized-path testing are permitted. Production or institutional activation of the authority a decision governs is prohibited until a duly authorized body adopts the decision.

labels.HISTORICALLY_EVIDENCED: The identifier is individually evidenced by a recovered historical record. Only the identifier and the recorded title or status are historical; the specification is new.
labels.PROPOSED_NEW_BASELINE: The specification is a new design in this proposed baseline. Every contract carries this label.
labels.IMPLEMENTED_SOURCE: The cited source files show some implementation. A cited file is not verification, conformance was not checked, and no run exists.
labels.REQUIRES_INSTITUTIONAL_ADOPTION: The behaviour depends on an institutional authority decision that is outstanding. It stays inactive until a duly authorized body adopts it.

CASE_OWNER_OR_ASSIGNEE.definition: A live owner or assignee relationship to this one case, held by a principal whose live membership carries a representation capacity (steward, chief steward or officer). The relationship is a fact about the case; the capacity is eligibility only. Closing, disclosing to the member and exporting sealed evidence are additionally limited to the primary handler.

CASE_PRIMARY_HANDLER_ONLY.definition: The owner or assignee relationship, limited to the primary handler. A collaborator grant can never carry these actions.

CASE_COLLABORATOR_EXPLICIT.definition: A live collaborator relationship that was granted explicitly by someone other than its holder, names each permission, carries an expiry, and never reaches privileged matters unless a separate independent privileged grant exists.

CASE_MEMBER_OWN.definition: The represented member or creator of this case, as a live derived relationship. It reaches only the member-visible view of the case.

CASE_SUPERVISORY_MANDATE.definition: A live supervisory mandate whose unit, territory or resource scope covers this case and whose powers name the action. Seniority, role title and platform status are not inputs. Privileged matters are outside every mandate except assignment.

CASE_TRIAGE_DESIGNATION.definition: A live, expiring, revocable triage designation for the cases scope, granted by an organization administrator to an eligible staff member for at most 90 days. It exposes the unassigned queue metadata only and grants no kernel action on any case.

CASE_FILING_CAPACITY.definition: An active canonical membership whose capacity allows opening a matter in the stated mode (member, handler or bulk). Opening a matter grants no access to anyone else’s case.

CASE_EMERGENCY_GRANT.definition: A live, justified, independently approved, time-boxed, read-only emergency grant that names this case. It never reaches privileged matters.

THREAD_PARTICIPANT.definition: The member of the conversation, or its assignee when that membership carries an assignee capacity. Participation follows the conversation row; no mandate and no delegation confers it.

THREAD_TRIAGE_DESIGNATION.definition: A live triage designation for the messages scope. It exposes the unassigned conversation queue only and is not a read of any conversation.

GOVERNANCE_MANDATE_THREAD_HOLD.definition: A live governance review mandate whose powers name the action and whose scope names the conversation or the organization retention record. It confers no read of the conversation and cannot be delegated.

DOCUMENT_CASE_RELATIONSHIP_AND_CLASS.definition: A kernel decision on the linked case together with the document classification. A privileged classification needs an explicit independent privileged-access grant; a role never reaches it.

DIRECTORY_SCOPE_BY_CASE_RELATIONSHIP.definition: The member directory policy: a steward sees self and the members of cases assigned to them; supervisory and officer scopes widen the directory without sensitive attributes only through the stated policy; only platform administrators cross organizations.

WORKAID_REFERRAL_WITH_CONSENT.definition: The case relationship that permits a referral, plus a live member disclosure consent whose categories, purpose, recipient and expiry cover what moves. A union-authored record can never open counsel material. Consent wording is an institutional instrument that this baseline does not write.

ORG_ADMIN_OPERATIONS.definition: Administration of the tenant. The organization administrator title carries no case, money or governance capacity; it may grant a time-boxed triage designation and perform tenant operations only.

REPRESENTATION_PROTOCOL_APPROVAL.definition: A representation protocol approved by an administrator who is not its author. An unapproved, missing or invalid protocol is not executable and fails closed.

SELF_SCOPED.definition: The signed-in principal’s own preferences and session. No other principal’s resource is touched.

ACTIVE_MEMBERSHIP_NAVIGATION.definition: A live membership in the active organization. A navigation entry is only an entry point: every resource behind it is decided individually, and an entry is not shown when its destination would resolve to an unavailable state.

FINANCIAL_MANDATE_VIEW.definition: A live financial mandate that names the account and the view duty, held by a principal with a financial capacity. A member may always view their own record. A role title, including the Secretary-Treasurer title, is not a mandate.

FINANCIAL_MANDATE_PREPARE.definition: A live financial mandate that names the account and the prepare duty. The implemented software rule SEP-SW-01 stops a preparer approving the same transaction; whether an institution adopts that separation is outstanding.

FINANCIAL_MANDATE_APPROVE.definition: A live financial mandate that names the account and the approve duty, within its monetary limit and currency. The implemented software rules SEP-SW-01 and SEP-SW-02 refuse an approver who prepared the same transaction or who later executes it. An adverse party is refused. Institutional adoption of the separation is outstanding.

FINANCIAL_MANDATE_EXECUTE.definition: A live financial mandate that names the account and the execute duty. Execution is the money movement itself and happens only in the route that moves the money. The implemented software rules SEP-SW-02 and SEP-SW-03 refuse an executor who prepared or approved the same transaction, and a reconciler who took part in it. Institutional adoption is outstanding.

FINANCIAL_MANDATE_RECONCILE.definition: A live financial mandate that names the account and the reconcile duty. The implemented software rule SEP-SW-03 refuses a reconciler who took part in the same transaction. Institutional adoption is outstanding.

FINANCIAL_MANDATE_AUDIT.definition: A live financial mandate that names the account and the audit duty. The implemented software rule SEP-SW-04 refuses an auditor who took part in the same transaction. Institutional adoption is outstanding.

FINANCIAL_SUBJECT_OWN_RECORD.definition: The member viewing their own financial record, and nothing else’s.

FINANCIAL_MANDATE_ADMINISTRATION.definition: Issuance, acceptance, suspension and revocation of a financial mandate under a live issuance rule. The implemented software rule SEP-SW-07 requires the issuer, the holder and the approver to be three different people, and SEP-SW-08 stops the issuer and approver activating the mandate; that is evidence of a software rule and not proof that an institution adopted it. The holder activates; an expired term is not activated. No mandate is issued from a request body or derived from a role title.

TRUSTEE_APPOINTMENT_DUTY.definition: The trustee capacity, which is earned only by a recorded appointment and never by role, together with a live mandate naming the duty.

AUDITOR_APPOINTMENT_DUTY.definition: The auditor capacity, which is earned only by a recorded appointment and never by role, together with a live mandate naming the audit duty and the period.

UNDECIDED_INSTITUTIONAL_OFFICE.definition: No source of authority is defined for this action. The institution must name the office, the mandate or the rule that holds it. Until then the action is not offered, and a role floor in the current source is not treated as that authority.

ROLE_ELIGIBILITY_ONLY.definition: A role, capacity, title or seniority makes a person eligible to hold an authority. It never is the authority. A denial contract names what a role never grants.

PLATFORM_BOUNDARY_NO_AUTHORITY.definition: Nzila platform billing is not union finance. Platform staff status and SaaS entitlement confer no authority over union financial records.

authorityStatesVocabulary.rule: An outstanding institutional authority decision does not stop engineering. It stops production or institutional activation of the authority the decision governs.

states.ENGINEERING_IMPLEMENTATION: PERMITTED. Drafts, queues, previews, read models, refusal paths and positive paths may be built.
states.SYNTHETIC_AUTHORIZED_PATH_TESTING: PERMITTED. A positive path may be demonstrated with test-issued authority in a synthetic organization that is marked synthetic and holds no real member, money or privileged record.
states.PRODUCTION_INSTITUTIONAL_ACTIVATION: PROHIBITED until a duly authorized body adopts the decision. No real organization receives the authority.
states.EXTERNAL_OR_INSTITUTIONAL_ADOPTION: REQUIRED. The decision is settled outside this repository and is recorded here only as outstanding.

syntheticAuthority.note: Test-issued authority exists only inside a test fixture. It is never copied into, derived from or promoted to a real organization.

prohibitedWithoutInstitutionalAdoption.prohibited: Issuing a real financial mandate. FINANCIAL_MANDATES_NOT_ISSUED stays the answer.
Establishing, naming or filling an institutional office, including a steward office.
Authorizing or executing a real payment, payment rail or export to an external accounting system.
Disclosing privileged, counsel-controlled or third-party restricted material to anyone.
Activating counsel execution or transmitting anything to counsel. UE-CONV-G-003 stays an external gate.

designNote: Product design decisions can be settled by the product specification review. Institutional authority decisions name who may issue, approve, decide or receive something. Nothing in this repository settles an institutional authority decision, so each stays outstanding and the behaviour it governs stays inactive.

decisions.title: Steward as a distinct persona
decisions.question: Is Steward a distinct persona with its own action contract, or the front-line capacity inside Representative 2.2?
decisions.baselineProposal: Steward is specified as its own persona with a distinct workspace. The workspace is a presentation choice that carries no authority. Five facts stay apart: interface persona, employment or union office, platform role, case relationship and issued authority. A distinct institutional office is not implied, and office and capacity are configurable per organization. Every steward action still names the Representative 2.2 action it narrows.
options: Distinct workspace with office and capacity configurable per organization (proposed)
Front-line capacity inside Representative 2.2
Distinct persona only where an institution configures a steward-led protocol

reviewerRecommendation.qualification: Distinct experience, configurable office and capacity. The persona does not imply a distinct institutional office or extra authority.

decisions.inactiveBehaviorUntilAdopted: The proposed behaviour is a design for review. Nothing is built from it before the review settles it.

decisions.title: Steward navigation
decisions.question: Which destinations does the steward see, and what decides whether one appears?
decisions.baselineProposal: Seven candidate destinations, each narrowed to the steward’s own relationships. A destination appears only while the signed-in principal can use at least one capability behind it, and it is hidden otherwise. No page count is promised. Knowledge & Guidance appears only while a clause-library capability is usable.
options: Capability-conditional candidate destinations (proposed)
A fixed set of seven narrowed destinations
A fixed set of five destinations without Communications and Knowledge

reviewerRecommendation.qualification: Visibility follows actual available functions, not a fixed seven-page promise.

decisions.inactiveBehaviorUntilAdopted: The proposed behaviour is a design for review. Nothing is built from it before the review settles it.

decisions.title: Default visibility of working notes
decisions.question: Is a representative working note staff-only unless the author chooses member visibility?
decisions.baselineProposal: Staff-only by default. A note becomes member-visible only after it is classified and an authorized disclosure decision is taken on the server. A visibility flag sent by a client is never sufficient. A communication written for the member is decided by case:comment, and disclosure of an existing staff-held record is decided separately by case:disclose_to_member for the primary handler. This keeps the repaired source default recorded as P0-F1 and records that source does not yet classify or record a disclosure decision.
options: Staff-only default with a classification and an authorized server-side disclosure decision (proposed)
Staff-only default with an author-chosen visibility flag
Member-visible default

reviewerRecommendation.qualification: Explicit member disclosure must still pass a server-side disclosure decision.

decisions.inactiveBehaviorUntilAdopted: The proposed behaviour is a design for review. Nothing is built from it before the review settles it.

decisions.title: Intake classification
decisions.question: How are an inquiry, a service request, a case, a formal grievance, a complaint, an appeal and a reconsideration distinguished, and how may they relate?
decisions.baselineProposal: Seven distinct entity types. None is a stage of another, none requires a prior entity, and no sequence is mandatory. Allowed links are optional and transitions are configured per organization protocol. Whether claims and grievances are one canonical entity or two stays unresolved under Gate 4 (UE-CAP-C-001) and is not decided here. An unassigned intake is metadata until a person accepts or routes it.
options: Seven distinct entity types with configurable links and transitions (proposed)
One mandatory linear sequence from inquiry to grievance
Two entity types: intake and case

reviewerRecommendation.qualification: Separate inquiry or request, accepted case, formal grievance and appeal without assuming one universal linear progression.

decisions.title: Assignment acknowledgement and handoff summary
decisions.question: What does an assignee acknowledge on receipt, and what must an outgoing handler record at handoff?
decisions.baselineProposal: The assignee acknowledges receipt; the outgoing handler records open deadlines, open communications, evidence state and the next step. Acknowledgement does not create authority. Acknowledgement does not transfer or create authority.

decisions.title: R18 status vocabulary
decisions.question: How is a historical disposition recorded beside the current implementation status?
decisions.baselineProposal: Two separate fields. The historical dispositions (BLOCKED, then MISSING) are kept as dated observations. The current implementation status is recorded from source and is never written over a historical observation. The historical disposition and the live implementation status stay separate fields.

reviewerRecommendation.qualification: Historical disposition and live implementation status remain separate.

decisions.baselineProposal: Seven proposed, testable workflows. They are specifications for later qualification and prove nothing now. No journey counts as passed until it is executed. Every journey records NOT_EXECUTED.

decisions.title: Financial navigation names
decisions.question: Confirm the three recovered navigation names and the four proposed names.
decisions.baselineProposal: Accounts & Cash, Budgets & Spending and Funds & Programs are recovered names. Dues & Remittances, Approvals & Payments, Reports & Records and Mandates & Oversight are proposed. Every destination carries a capability state derived from the contracts behind it. A destination whose capabilities are all unavailable is not advertised, and a page that exists does not imply an operational finance engine. Nzila platform billing surfaces are not union finance destinations.
options: Capability-state derived navigation (proposed)
A fixed set of seven destinations
Only destinations with a full implementation

reviewerRecommendation.qualification: Do not imply union financial operations are implemented where they remain unavailable.

decisions.title: Financial journeys FJ01–FJ10
decisions.question: Are FJ01–FJ10 accepted as the ten proposed workflows, and how is separation of duties modelled?
decisions.baselineProposal: Ten proposed, testable workflows. Viewing, preparing, approving, executing, reconciling and auditing stay separate powers. Whether one principal may hold two of them is decided by a separation rule evaluated against the transaction, account, amount, mandate, approval and principal. The model distinguishes mandatory technical protections, implemented software rules and proposed institutional rules. No rule is assumed for consecutive steps, and the three-person issuance design is evidence of an implemented software rule and not proof of institutional adoption.
options: Rule-driven separation evaluated per transaction, account and principal (proposed)
Every consecutive duty held by a different person
No separation beyond a mandate

reviewerRecommendation.qualification: Distinct financial duties do not mean every consecutive step universally requires a different person.

decisions.inactiveBehaviorUntilAdopted: The proposed behaviour is a design for review. Nothing is built from it before the review settles it.

decisions.title: Deadline extension workflow
decisions.question: Is requesting an extension distinct from granting one?
decisions.baselineProposal: Distinct. A steward requests an extension with a reason; granting is an institutional decision. Requesting an extension records a request only. It does not change the legal or contractual deadline or its effect.

reviewerRecommendation.qualification: Requesting an extension does not modify its legal or contractual effect.

decisions.inactiveBehaviorUntilAdopted: The proposed behaviour is a design for review. Nothing is built from it before the review settles it.

decisions.title: Financial reporting scope
decisions.question: Which reports and exports does the Financial Officer baseline cover, and what authorizes them?
decisions.baselineProposal: Reports are views over records the viewer holds a view duty on, and a view duty alone does not authorize a report, an aggregate, member-level rows or an export. Disclosed fields, aggregation, scope, sensitivity, export and inference risk are each authorized separately. An export is a separate duty-checked action with its own record. Nzila platform billing reports are not union finance reports.
options: Separately authorized reports, aggregates and exports (proposed)
A view duty authorizes every report over its records
No reports in this baseline

reviewerRecommendation.qualification: Aggregation, export and inference risks require separate authorization.

decisions.inactiveBehaviorUntilAdopted: The proposed behaviour is a design for review. Nothing is built from it before the review settles it.

decisions.title: Organization scenario coverage
decisions.question: Is the stated scenario set (CAPE, CUPE, LIUNA, small local) the right set to specify, and are the stated structures the right way to represent them?
decisions.baselineProposal: Four scenarios that are not interchangeable. CAPE and CUPE are source-backed. LIUNA and the small local are hypotheses that need discovery with the institution. The four scenarios are independently configurable and independently validated. None borrows another’s configuration, and the two hypotheses stay hypotheses until discovery with the institution.

reviewerRecommendation.qualification: CAPE, CUPE, LIUNA and small-local workflows must remain independently configurable and validated.

decisions.title: Dues data access for presidents and administrators
decisions.question: Do presidents and administrators receive any access to member dues data, through a mandate store or an interim allow-list?
decisions.engineeringMayBuild: An explicit allow-list read path and a mandate-store read model.
decisions.syntheticTestMay: A test allow-list entry in a synthetic organization exercising member dues reads.
decisions.inactiveBehaviorUntilAdopted: Only the existing explicit allow-list reads member financial data. A title is not a mandate.

decisions.title: Financial succession and revocation
decisions.question: What happens to financial mandates when an office-holder leaves, is suspended or is replaced?
decisions.engineeringMayBuild: The revocation and expiry paths and a succession preview.
decisions.syntheticTestMay: A test fixture exercising revocation and replacement.
decisions.inactiveBehaviorUntilAdopted: A mandate that is not live is not honoured. Revocation is immediate once recorded; no automatic succession is applied.

decisions.title: External accounting export and retention
decisions.question: Who may export to an external accounting system, and what retention rule applies?
decisions.engineeringMayBuild: The export record and a stub export target.
decisions.syntheticTestMay: A stub target exercising export with synthetic records. No external system is called.
decisions.inactiveBehaviorUntilAdopted: No export to an external system is offered.

decisions.title: Tax slip issuance authority
decisions.question: Who may issue tax slips and receipts, and under which registration?
decisions.engineeringMayBuild: The slip and receipt draft and a preview.
decisions.syntheticTestMay: A synthetic registration exercising slip drafting. No slip is issued or filed.
decisions.inactiveBehaviorUntilAdopted: No tax slip is issued or filed by the application under this baseline.

decisions.title: Financial adoption by organization
decisions.question: Which organizations adopt the financial baseline and when, given that institutions differ?
decisions.engineeringMayBuild: An organization-level adoption switch that defaults to off.
decisions.syntheticTestMay: A synthetic organization with the switch on, exercising the financial baseline.
decisions.inactiveBehaviorUntilAdopted: The baseline is active for no organization.

decisions.title: Steward role scope per organization
decisions.question: Which actions a steward holds in each organization, given the protocol each adopts?
decisions.engineeringMayBuild: Per-organization steward scope configuration that defaults to relationship-only scope.
decisions.syntheticTestMay: A synthetic organization with a test protocol exercising steward scope.
decisions.inactiveBehaviorUntilAdopted: A steward holds only what a live relationship to a case gives. Protocol-specific scope is not applied.
